Input3 is BOOK SERIES TITLE DESIGN reference: same warm dimensional woodland illustration and dark forest-green graceful large serif lettering in the upper third, not its characters or burrow.
Create the cover for The Forest Academy. Exact Russian lettering: prominent top 'Мистер Пин-Пин', below 'Академия Леса'. Only these words, perfectly spelled Cyrillic, readable balanced lines; no extra words, English, numerals, logos, watermark or decorative badges. Leave a calm softly luminous sky opening in upper third for this large lettering with comfortable margins, framed by soft oak leaves.
Below the title, a charming clear group of exactly three young friends at the roots of the established academy oak: small cream-faced chestnut-quilled PinPin near center-front, taller soft gray-beige rabbit Lulu left with two long upright ears and pale muzzle/chest, red squirrel Tutu right with one bushy curled tail, cream belly and small tufted ears. Lulu's body larger than PinPin; Tutu body similar to PinPin but tail taller. All paws naturally grounded or resting, no extra limbs. A few white daisies at roots suggest their afternoon craft, but no finished crown or loose handheld props. Keep the familiar warm expressive faces and rich tactile fur/quills from character reference. This is a peaceful cover scene, not a classroom diagram.
The mossy four-post open-sided timber pavilion appears smaller in the left middle distance, with its low log benches. Oak trunk and spreading roots frame the right side. Soft green woodland and golden afternoon light. No pond, no new doors/windows/fences/classroom wall; no hollow burrow door in the oak. The school environment stays inviting and physically believable. Clear hierarchy of title and three hero faces, restrained background contrast, detailed natural materials, cinematic soft depth; no flat cartoon, plastic toy style or overexposure. Full uncropped portrait composition with all three complete characters and rabbit ears/tail inside frame.
